description: This source file defines a custom Android widget class StaticPointerIconButton that extends Button. It overrides the method to resolve the pointer icon (mouse cursor), providing a custom icon using a drawable resource.

classes.name: StaticPointerIconButton
classes.description: A custom Button that displays a specific pointer icon (cursor) when hovered, using a drawable resource as the icon.

methods.name: onResolvePointerIcon
methods.description: Overrides the method to provide a custom PointerIcon based on a drawable resource, creating it if not already initialized.
